style: Candid editorial nightlife photograph shot on a 35mm point-and-shoot film camera with hard direct on-camera flash: subjects crisp and bright, background falling off into deep black, slightly blown highlights, natural film grain, subtle vignetting, warm skin tones with coral-red and magenta accents from club lights, authentic and energetic, like a cool Gen Z party photographer's Instagram. Real-looking people aged 20 to 28, diverse, stylish casual outfits, genuine emotion and a bit of motion blur. Absolutely no text, no letters, no logos, no brand names, no watermarks, no drugs, no visible alcohol bottles. Vertical 4:5 framing.

decors.prompt: Halloween night party in a club on the French Riviera: young adults in elaborate, clearly recognizable Halloween costumes (vampire with fangs, witch hat, skeleton face paint, zombie makeup, devil horns), carved glowing jack-o'-lanterns and pumpkins everywhere, fake spiderwebs, orange and purple lights, smoke, candid direct flash.

Magical Christmas party night on the French Riviera: snow gently falling, young friends laughing in Santa hats and ugly Christmas sweaters, a big decorated Christmas tree with warm lights, wrapped presents, red and white decorations, string lights on palm trees, festive and cosy, candid direct flash.

New Year's Eve party on the French Riviera: young friends in glamorous gold and black outfits counting down with sparklers, gold confetti raining, gold and silver balloons, glitter everywhere, fireworks exploding over the sea behind, candid direct flash.

New Year's party on the French Riviera at midnight: friends hugging and cheering under a shower of gold confetti and streamers, party hats and gold balloons, fireworks in the sky, glitter, euphoric faces, candid direct flash.

Valentine's night party in a stylish bar on the French Riviera: red heart-shaped balloons, pink neon heart sign without text, rose petals, young couples and friends laughing, red and pink lights, candid direct flash.

Fête de la musique in the streets of the old town of Nice: a live band and a DJ playing outside, guitars and speakers, a huge joyful crowd dancing in the street, warm string lights, summer night, candid direct flash.

Bastille Day night on the Promenade in Nice: huge blue, white and red fireworks over the sea, French tricolor flags waving, a cheering crowd of young people on the beach, summer outfits, candid direct flash.
